reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes and links to a spin-to-earn app while claiming that spinning and sharing can produce Paytm-style cash, daily money, and specified rupee amounts. It demonstrates participation, rewards, coin conversion, and payout options requiring Paytm, PayPal, or bank details. Although an educational disclaimer is present and no completed payout is shown, the title, download link, earning claims, and app walkthrough support promotion of an unusually easy cash-earning mechanism.

opening.argument: The creator expressly frames the material as educational: the description says, “Video is for educational purpose only.” That qualification matters because the video presents an app process for viewers to inspect, rather than representing every displayed balance or conversion as an independently verified result. The educational framing and incomplete transaction evidence support treating this as informational content with uncertainty, not deceptive certification.
